name: Corn Syrup
siboNotes: Pure corn syrup is primarily glucose and generally well-tolerated in SIBO. Avoid high-fructose corn syrup which contains excess fructose.
preparationTips: Check labels carefully - ensure it's pure corn syrup, not high-fructose corn syrup
Use in baking as a low-FODMAP liquid sweetener alternative
Store at room temperature and use within 2 years for best quality
Can be substituted 1:1 for other liquid sweeteners in recipes
